The Electron app registers a custom protocol but does not support deep linking to open specific projects or chat threads from external sources like browser links.

Implementation
Register t3code:// protocol handler in t3code/apps/desktop/src/electron/protocol.ts
Support URL patterns: t3code://open/project?path=/path/to/repo, t3code://chat/thread?id=abc123, t3code://settings
Parse the URL and route to the correct view in the web app via IPC
Handle the case where the app is not running: launch the app and then navigate
Validate URL parameters to prevent path traversal attacks in the project path
Acceptance Criteria
Clicking t3code:// links in a browser opens the desktop app
Project links open the specified project directory
Chat links navigate to the specified thread
Settings link opens the settings panel
Path traversal attempts in project path are rejected
If app is already running, it focuses the existing window and navigates
If app is not running, it launches and then navigates after readiness
Invalid URLs show an error notification instead of crashing
Protocol registration works on macOS, Windows, and Linux
